research_direction: Is there a midtrain dose at which the corpus moves the model's own behaviour AND the model still follows instructions? A four-point anchor-fraction ladder (4/6/8/12%) of one corpus, with a pre-registered format-competence floor that voids any arm below it. The 6% arm is the first cell in this line of work with a POSITIVE midtrain main effect, so its interaction is not of the suppressed-main-effect kind.
